limitations: WRITE_BLOCK_NOT_VERIFIED: BLKROSET was set and BLKROGET read it back as applied, which establishes that the kernel holds this device read-only. It does not establish that a write would be refused - proving that requires attempting one, and this tool never writes to an evidence device. Qualify the interface once against scratch media with scripts/probe-write-block.py and keep the result. Note also that BLKROSET governs the block layer only: SG_IO and ATA pass-through writes bypass it entirely, as does a partition node whose own flag was never set.
